complete.description: True only after every required repository-reading pass has completed and its result has been consolidated.

summary.description: Technical-documentation summary with one material change introduced by the pull request per bullet.

description.description: One to three short sentences for the person deciding whether to merge that state what to do and the material product, test, or CI behavior that justifies it.

issue.description: One concise, factual technical statement using the strongest rationale without repeating evidence or asking a rhetorical question.

impact.description: One concise, factual technical consequence of the changed behavior.

required_change.description: One specific technical action required to resolve the finding, written as a direct imperative.

unverified.description: One factual evidence gap in technical-documentation style, or none.

question.description: One direct material technical question whose answer may change the review outcome, or none; do not use conversational phrasing.
